paragraphs: He is mentioned in Kohelet Rabbah 1:2; Hyman infers from the passage that he lived after R' Zeira’s death.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital paragraph beginning רבי אבא בר כהנא ואמרי לה בשם רבי אדא בר חוניא appears in Kohelet Rabbah 1:4 in that digital numbering. Hyman’s supplied locator 1:2 is retained. The witness fully writes Rabbi Ada, whereas Hyman’s heading fully writes Rav Ada; both forms are preserved.

The whole saved Midrash Rabbah -- TE Kohelet Rabbah1 paragraph provides an alternative attribution to Rabbi Ada bar Chunya and the conditional wording about Zeira no longer being alive. Hyman’s supplied 1:2 locator remains; the existing note records the different digital division. The chronology remains Hyman’s inference from that wording, not an independently established date or authority identification. Hyman’s explicit Rav title in the heading remains distinct from the digital Rabbi Ada. The body deliberately keeps the source abbreviation as R' Zeira although the paragraph supplies a full Rabbi title locally. The existing note remains verbatim. No other names, scriptural examples or teachings from the long digital paragraph are imported. This is digital text evidence, not printed lettering or correction history.
